description.en: Drop-in electric fryer with 10 l capacity, dimensions 400 × 600 × 390 mm, tank 220 × 350 × 230 mm, basket 200 × 300 × 100 mm, output 10 kg/h.

construction.en: Stainless steel AISI 304, dual thermostat (operating and safety), tank filter, tilting heating element for easy cleaning.

construction.cs: Nerez AISI 304, dvojitý termostat (provozní a bezpečnostní), filtr vany, sklopné topné těleso pro snadné čištění.
